content: Rust CQF availability: qfilter (arthurprs, MIT, ~1M downloads, maintained) is RSQF variant, fingerprint API on u64 hashes, xxhash3, deletions/merging/resizing/serde, requires popcnt x86_64 (legacy feature ~10% slower) - approximate NOT exact-u32. COMBINE-lab/cqf-rust wraps C++ CQF true qf_insert(item,count)/qf_count_key_value, libssl+Haswell build (MSRV/maturin/PyO3 risk). mqf v1.0.0 2019 C++ bindings stale. No pure-Rust exact-u32 CQF found; would need building. Defer.
